description: North Central Province Provincial Council - Mrs. T. Thilakarathne and 14 others - Appointed to the Posts of Provincial Council Services
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists personnel appointments (named individuals being appointed to specific government posts) without detailing their portfolio responsibilities or describing structural changes to government ministries. The content focuses on "who" is being appointed to which position, but does not include descriptions of "what" those positions are responsible for in terms of subject areas or ministerial portfolios.
